A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BiomedCoOp and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary material. Existing content can be matched reliably across appendix renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original biomedical classification experiments, base-to-novel evaluations, ablations, and visual analyses in Section 4 and the supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds baseline comparisons and an experiment comparing different prompt-generating language models.

M1.justification: The proposed BiomedCLIP-based procedure, SCCM and KDSP components, outlier-selection rule, and combined training objective remain unchanged. Alternative language models and selective zero-shot ensembling are evaluated as variants or controls.

E1.justification: The biomedical datasets, classification tasks, and visual-analysis examples are retained. The new comparisons reuse existing benchmarks, and the LLM experiment uses BTMRI, COVID-QU-Ex, and CTKidney, all already evaluated in v1.

E2.justification: v2 adds evaluated XCoOp and DCPL* baselines in both few-shot and base-to-novel comparisons (Tables S2–S3), substantially broadening comparison to biomedical and deep multimodal adaptation methods. Table 1 also adds BiomedCLIP with selective ensembling as a zero-shot comparator.

E3.justification: The new LLM experiment uses 50 prompts and four-shot evaluation on three retained datasets, varying GPT-4, LLaMA-3-8b, and Gemma-2-2b. New baseline configurations specify BiomedCLIP integration, including its use as DCPL*'s domain model. Existing splits, training budgets, and shot schedules are unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds a focused LLM-choice robustness study (Table S4) and a zero-shot comparison isolating selective versus ordinary prompt ensembling. Existing component, context-length, prompt-count, selection-threshold, backbone, and interpretability analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions specify three runs and report standard deviations from three sampled support sets. Added tables extend uncertainty reporting to new results; no increased run count, new confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedure is reported.

E6.justification: v2 substantially expands comparative results while retaining existing values. Table S3 adds harmonic means of 68.43% for XCoOp and 50.84% for DCPL*, alongside the retained BiomedCoOp result of 75.07%. Selective zero-shot ensembling scores 53.72%, versus 52.27% for ordinary ensembling. Tables S2 and S4 additionally report new few-shot baseline and alternative-LLM results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Equations 1–11 are retained. Neither the main text nor supplement introduces or revises formal assumptions, propositions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same novelty, efficient adaptation, accuracy, and generalization claims. The stated coverage of 11 datasets, nine modalities, and ten organs remains unchanged.

C2.justification: New supplementary Section 13 interprets similar performance across prompt-generating LLMs, including smaller models, as robustness to different text distributions and attributes this to prompt selection. Existing mechanism explanations and applicability statements are retained.

D1.justification: The abstract changes code availability from a promised release to a stated public release. The added comparisons explain how XCoOp and DCPL* incorporate BiomedCLIP. Existing hardware, hyperparameter tables, and example prompts are retained.

R1.justification: The same 53 cited works and related-work discussion are retained. XCoOp and DCPL were already discussed in v1; their new experimental evaluation does not revise the central novelty or research-positioning statements.

P1.justification: Changes include revised author affiliations and contact information, an acknowledgment, two inserted supplementary sections, and updated numbering and cross-references. The main scientific narrative remains substantially verbatim.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables S2–S4 and a row in Table 1, relocates and renumbers later supplementary tables, and resizes Figures 1 and 3. Existing visual content and the overall two-column organization are retained.

improvement.justification: The added XCoOp/DCPL* comparisons, selective-ensemble control, and smaller-LLM experiment strengthen empirical support for the retained method. The stated code release improves reproducibility information. These are useful, limited gains: new baseline comparisons are aggregated, and LLM robustness is examined on only three datasets.
